text: うちの　じいさま　ポケモンの　こうかんに　こってるの　あなた　ポケモン　ずかん　あつめてるなら　こうかんの　あいて　して　あげて　くれるかしら

structure.jp: ポケモンの　こうかんに　こってるの
ポケモン　ずかん　あつめてるなら
こうかんの　あいて　して　あげて　くれるかしら
structure.en: I wonder if you'd be his trading partner for me

patterns.name: 〜てあげる
patterns.explanation: あげる after a て-form verb says the action is done as a kindness for someone, here the old man. あいて して あげて = 'be his partner, for him'.

patterns.name: 〜てくれる
patterns.explanation: くれる after a て-form verb says someone does it as a favour to the speaker. Stacked on あげて, she asks you to do him a kindness as a favour to her. して あげて くれる = 'do that for him, for my sake'.

patterns.name: 〜なら
patterns.explanation: なら after a phrase means 'if that is the case'. あつめてるなら = 'if you're collecting'.
